turns.assessment: The correlated evidence localizes the fault to the fibre segment immediately upstream of oms.S04-S20.amp2. Both input and output power at amp2 fell by about 8.3 dB, and amp3 showed the same loss, while amp1 output and all pump currents were unchanged; this rules strongly against an amplifier gain or pump fault. The resulting all-channel power and OSNR degradation at S20 then propagated downstream. The likely cause is increased span loss, but the fibre segment has no exact named element identifier in the brief, so a repair commitment cannot be made under the location constraint.

proposals.rationale: The roughly 8.3 dB loss first appears at amp2 input and remains through amp2 output, amp3 input/output, and the S20 OCM across many channels. Unchanged amp1 output and unchanged pump currents place the loss in the fibre span between amp1 and amp2 rather than within an amplifier.
A gain drop at the preceding amplifier could reduce every downstream channel, but its monitored output power saw no change, making this explanation very unlikely.
